description: Source code for a Notion database document loader component in a larger data processing system, implementing the INode interface, with methods for initializing and loading documents from Notion API.

classes.name: NotionDB_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a document loader for Notion databases, conforming to the INode interface, capable of loading and processing documents from Notion API.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the NotionDB_DocumentLoaders instance with configuration parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously loads documents from Notion database, applies optional text splitting and metadata processing, and returns either documents or concatenated text.
